title: Wheels on the Move with Benny

scenes.description: Waiting for the Yellow School Bus at the Stop
Riding a Colorful Bicycle on the Park Trail
Watching Fast Trains and High Airplanes on the Hill

character_line.en: Look! Here comes the big yellow school bus!
character_line.zh: 你看！大大的黃色校車開過來囉！

options.en: The bus is so big and yellow!
The bus is a tiny purple fly.
options.zh: 公車是一隻小小的紫色蒼蠅。
options.hint: 公車是 bus，黃色的校車很大台喔！
注意看開過來的大公車（bus）喔！

character_line.en: Do you take the bus to school?
character_line.zh: 你平時都是坐公車去上學嗎？

options.en: Yes, I ride the bus every morning.
options.zh: 對啊，我每天早上都坐公車去學校。

options.en: No, I fly on an angry eagle.
options.zh: 不，我都騎生氣的老鷹在天上飛。
options.hint: 搭乘大眾交通工具可以用「ride the bus」來回答！
跟 Benny 聊聊你上學是怎麼去的吧！

character_line.en: In the park, can you ride a bicycle?
character_line.zh: 在公園裡，你會騎腳踏車嗎？

options.en: Yes! I can ride my bicycle fast!
options.zh: 會呀！我可以騎著腳踏車前進！

options.en: I ride a wooden soup bowl.
options.hint: 腳踏車是 bicycle（或 bike）喔！
回答 Benny「Yes! I can ride my bicycle fast!」吧！

character_line.en: Remember to wear your safety helmet!
character_line.zh: 騎車時要記得戴好安全帽喔！

options.en: I always wear my helmet. Safety first!
options.zh: 我一定會戴安全帽。安全第一！

options.en: I put a pizza on my head.
options.zh: 我把披薩戴在頭上當帽子。
options.hint: 保護頭部的安全帽叫 helmet 喔！
戴上安全帽（helmet）快樂又安全！

character_line.en: Choo-choo! Do you hear the fast train?
character_line.zh: 嘟嘟——！你有聽見快速開過的火車聲嗎？

options.en: Yes! The train is moving so fast!
The train is a slow little turtle.
options.zh: 火車是一隻慢吞吞的小烏龜。
options.hint: 在軌道上奔馳的火車是 train 喔！
看火車（train）快速奔馳的模樣吧！

character_line.en: Look up! An airplane is in the sky!
character_line.zh: 抬頭看！天空上有一架大飛機耶！

options.en: Wow! The airplane flies so high!
options.zh: 哇！飛機飛得好高好遠喔！

options.en: The airplane is swimming in the bathtub.
options.zh: 飛機正在浴缸裡面游泳。
options.hint: 在天空中飛翔的是飛機（airplane）喔！
跟 Benny 一起看高高飛行的 airplane 吧！
